WITH customer_first AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) AS first_order_date
  FROM orders.orders GROUP BY customer_id
),
period_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         o.customer_id,
         CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_date,
         CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= DATE '2017-08-01' AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) < DATE '2017-09-01' THEN 'window'
              WHEN CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= DATE '2017-07-01' AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) < DATE '2017-08-01' THEN 'baseline'
            END AS period
  FROM orders.orders o
  WHERE CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= DATE '2017-07-01'
    AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) < DATE '2017-09-01'
),
cust_type AS (
  SELECT po.customer_id,
         po.period,
         CASE WHEN cf.first_order_date >= CASE po.period WHEN 'window' THEN DATE '2017-08-01' ELSE DATE '2017-07-01' END
              AND cf.first_order_date < CASE po.period WHEN 'window' THEN DATE '2017-09-01' ELSE DATE '2017-08-01' END
              THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END AS cust_type
  FROM period_orders po
  JOIN customer_first cf ON cf.customer_id = po.customer_id
  WHERE po.period IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'window' AND cust_type = 'new' THEN customer_id END) AS DOUBLE)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN customer_id END), 0), 4) AS value,
  ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' AND cust_type = 'new' THEN customer_id END) AS DOUBLE)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN customer_id END), 0), 4) AS baseline,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN customer_id END) AS window_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN customer_id END) AS baseline_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'window' AND cust_type = 'new' THEN customer_id END) AS window_new_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' AND cust_type = 'new' THEN customer_id END) AS baseline_new_customers
FROM cust_type;
